title.narrative: Livelihoods Support & Environmental Regeneration through the use of Eco-Friendly Briquettes in FCT.

description.narrative:
to make available, an affordable cooking energy substitute to consumers that can easily be accessed, and also support a benign environment through stemming deforestation and reduced emission of greenhouse gas to the atmosphere. JDPC intends to run a state-of-the-art briquette plant in the Federal Capital Territory. To achieve this purpose and given our technological knowhow, a moderate cost commercial briquette machine will be designed, fabricated and deployed in FCT so as to provide cheap energy, stop deforestation and desertification. The machine can operate on solar energy. Solar panels would be explored to achieve our intended design. This will produce Direct Current (DC) voltage. They can be built to provide nearly any DC voltage.
Fossil fuels are the major source for energy. The excess use of these fuels will lead to serious environmental issues like global warming and air pollution. Since the fossil fuels are getting depleted day by day, it is the high time to convert biomass wastes to useful biomass briquettes which will be the substitute for some of the fossil fuels.To address this energy challenge in Nigeria, JDPC with prompting from CAFOD is exploring other biomass resources namely: energy crops (grasses), agricultural waste, solid waste, shrubs and woods as viable feedstock for alternative energy production. Biomass resources of Nigeria can be identified as wood, forage grasses and shrubs, animal waste and waste arising from forestry, agricultural, municipal and industrial activities, as well as, aquatic biomass. To meet the future energy and climate goals, bio-energy will play a crucial role.
This project is part of CAFOD's contribution to both the cry of the earth and cry of the poor in Nigeria. The Nigerian Bishops Conference of Nigeria recently launched a 5-year Tree planning and environmental regeneration strategy. This project aligns and foster this vision for sustainable environmental reorientation and transformation in Nigeria.
